adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts` the helper mutates the parsed data: if `refresh_token` is missing it sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (lines ~24-27). Call sites then spread/merge the returned `.data` into existing credentials, e.g. Office365: `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };` (in `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`). When the provider omits `refresh_token` (which is common/optional on refresh), this overwrites the previously stored real refresh token with the literal string, causing loss of the real refresh token and breaking subsequent refreshes.
